description: Stimulsoft Dashboards.WIN is a set of components that allows you to add analytics to your .NET application. The dashboard components are designed for both WinForms and WPF technologies. Data can be rendered using various widgets, from tables and charts to gauges. The product supports a variety of data sources such as SQL, CSV, JSON, and others.
